card.text: The secondary star of an eclipsing pair in the Andromeda Galaxy, one orbit every 3.549694 days.

sources.label: Ribas et al. (2005), ApJ 635, L37

introduction.text: It has 15.0 solar masses and 11.3 solar radii; its partner has 23.1 and 13.1. The pair gave a direct distance to the galaxy: 772 kiloparsecs.
